caseName: International Union of Operating Engineers, Local 150 v. Flair Builders, Inc.
caseNameFull: International Union of Operating Engineers, Local 150, AFL-CIO v. Flair Builders, Inc.

opinions.text: [Certiorari granted, 404 U. S. 982.] Request for additional time for filing brief for respondent granted and 30 additional days allotted for that purpose. Typewritten briefs may be filed in lieu of printed briefs. J. Robert Murphy, Esquire, of Aurora, Illinois, invited to file a brief and argue in this case as amicus curiae in support of judgment below.
